sentences: A deterministic protocol partitions a communication matrix into monochromatic regions corresponding to its transcripts.
The source asks for the optimal gap between communication cost and the logarithm of the smallest monochromatic partition.
A small partition provides a static decomposition but may not supply an efficient interactive method for locating the right piece.
The gap measures precisely that additional organizational cost.

The saved note requires the source's partition conventions and asymptotic parameterization, and bounds for covers or nondeterministic certificates should not be substituted for the disjoint partition measure.
